# Provenance: lunar frame campaign rank decisions, 50-digit mpmath oracle

- `inputs.json`: Kshana's own committed inputs, written on 2026-10-02 after the pre-registration
  commit `b84ce19b` by
  `KSHANA_WRITE_MPMATH_FIXTURE=1 cargo test --test lunar_frame_campaign_rank_mpmath_oracle engine_inputs_match_the_committed_fixture -- --ignored`
  (the test was still ignored then): for the 40 days 2026-03-15 to 2026-04-23, stations
  estimated, the engine's delay Jacobian, weights, station-column count and Helmert design.
  SHA-256 `0128e9d4ad8847850578df4418314dba689ba4ce113b1080f7410ce38a0c8816`.
- `reference.json`: the output of `gen_reference.py`, run once on 2026-10-02. SHA-256
  `40b30042bac344e43cbaefdd3457b165ffefdcb643bfe50e7dcb23dd6ca21f8e`
  (`gen_reference.py` `90278d5ae1c4d4e473094692916b3651491114e783b58edd5a1e0b7af34d0f84`). The
  script imports its matrix helpers unchanged from
  `../lunar_frame_campaign_mpmath_oracle/gen_reference.py`.
- **Tools:** mpmath 1.3.0 (BSD-3-Clause) at 50 digits, checked at 80; Python 3.11.15; run as a
  separate program from `$ORACLE_PY` of `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh`; nothing is linked into
  kshana.
- **Licence of the committed files:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only); no third-party
  data.
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py inputs.json > reference.json`.
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_frame_campaign_rank_mpmath_oracle.rs`.
